text:
{faith:earth}管结构、秩序、体积与空间，信徒不多。奉祂时，一场里有【大地】、有【穹顶】，经验值再多给。献祭只收大块的东西，换的经验值还要乘格子数。大地之神赐福中体积以上的道具，赐福版激活即加耐力上限。

奉了祂就有【天地】：边缘贴近棋盘边界的道具成为【大地】，不是大地、又落在棋盘中央那一圈的道具成为【穹顶】，夹在中间的是【支柱】。东西怎么摆就是哪一种。进入对局和 {level:qual} 级各选一张大地之神的质变牌（磐石、天光、支柱、苦劳、修行、万象……），有的看大地和穹顶各有几件，有的看负重；升级时还会出大地之神的基础牌。

texts.en:
{faith:earth} governs structure, order, volume and space, and has few followers. While you follow this god, you gain extra XP in a battle when you have Earth and Dome items. This god accepts only large items as Offerings, and the XP they give is multiplied by their cell count. The God of the Earth blesses medium-size and larger items: a Blessed version raises max Stamina on activation.

Following this god gives you Heaven and Earth: items whose edge touches the Board's border become Earth; items that are not Earth and sit in the Board's central ring become Dome; the ones in between are Pillars. Where you place an item decides which it is. At the start of a run and at levels {level:qual} you pick one of the god's Qualitative cards (Bedrock, Skylight, Pillars, Toil, Discipline, All Things...): some count your Earth and Dome items, some look at your Load. Level-ups also offer the god's base cards.
